recognize_zh: 中央嗜中性球的核分成至少 6 個小葉、葉間細絲相連，屬分葉過多；周圍紅血球多為大而飽滿的卵圓形、中央淡染區不明顯（巨卵圓形紅血球），兩者合併提示巨母紅血球性變化。
features: Neutrophil with six or more small nuclear lobes connected by thin filaments
Condensed chromatin; pale pink cytoplasm with fine granules
Background red cells with many large oval, well-hemoglobinized forms (macro-ovalocytes) with reduced central pallor
Mild anisocytosis with occasional smaller round red cells; no inclusions evident
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil with six or more nuclear lobes connected by thin chromatin strands and finely granular cytoplasm. The background red cells show anisocytosis with numerous large, oval, well-hemoglobinized cells with diminished central pallor, consistent with macro-ovalocytes. No red cell inclusions are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with a hypersegmented neutrophil with macro-ovalocytes, supporting megaloblastic change; vitamin B12 and folate levels should be assessed.

ddx.vs: Normal neutrophils have two to five lobes, while this cell has six or more lobes.
MDS may show macrocytosis but more often hypolobated (pseudo-Pelger-Huët) hypogranular neutrophils, with normal B12/folate.
Morphology is identical and is separated only by medication history with normal vitamin levels.
